source_note: Provisional scorer output score-provisional-3/out-O1S (3 Oct 2026). Not a release; numbers can change before GO.
headline: A

equating.rule: median over complete full-coverage self-hosted systems of metric(S u P) - metric(A u P), per metric (Intelligence, Calibration); API value = clip(raw_A + offset)
equating.pool_note: Median over the complete full-coverage self-hosted systems of this run (at least five required).

v16.g_med_rule: median gap over ranked self-hosted systems; API systems use the same systems' P-vs-A gap
v16.long_items_note: 23 items of this draw are very long (about 77,000 to 81,000 input tokens). Systems with a shorter context window refuse them; Jev-Omni runs out of GPU memory on them on its listed RTX 6000 (48 GB) recipe; decider-4b v2's server truncates them to about 32,800 tokens and answers; Plumb-4B reads them in full. Each outcome is the system's own recipe and is scored as such.
